questions.question: Which two European powers were the main rivals in the French and Indian War?
choices: Spain and Portugal
Great Britain and France
France and Russia
Great Britain and Spain

questions.question: Which disputed region helped spark the French and Indian War in 1754?
choices: The Ohio River valley
The Mississippi Delta
The Great Basin
The Hudson Bay coast

questions.question: Which larger conflict included the French and Indian War?
choices: The War of Spanish Succession
The Thirty Years' War
The Napoleonic Wars
The Seven Years' War

questions.question: Which young Virginia officer commanded at Fort Necessity in 1754?
choices: Thomas Jefferson
Benjamin Franklin
George Washington
John Adams

questions.question: What did Benjamin Franklin's Albany Plan of Union propose in 1754?
choices: Joint colonial cooperation under a common council
Independence from the British monarchy
The transfer of Canada to Spain
The abolition of colonial assemblies

questions.question: Which treaty formally ended the French and Indian War in 1763?
choices: Treaty of Ghent
Treaty of Paris
Treaty of Versailles
Treaty of Tordesillas

questions.question: Which city did British forces capture after the Battle of the Plains of Abraham in 1759?
choices: Boston
New Orleans
Quebec
Charleston

questions.question: Why did France build forts in the Ohio River valley before the war?
choices: To establish plantation farming as Canada's main industry
To shift Atlantic shipping away from coastal ports
To control the British colonial assemblies
To strengthen its territorial claims and trade routes

questions.question: Why did different Indigenous nations choose different alliances during the war?
choices: They had different trade relationships and territorial interests
They all followed orders from a single continental ruler
Their alliances were determined by British voting districts
Their leaders had identical goals for European settlement

questions.question: Why was control of waterways valuable in this conflict?
choices: Rivers marked every colonial border
Waterways supported transportation, supply, and trade
Ships could travel across all mountain ranges
River access removed the need for forts

questions.question: How did Britain's wartime debt contribute to later colonial tensions?
choices: It led Britain to abandon tax collection
It gave colonial assemblies control over Parliament
It ended British interest in North America
It encouraged Parliament to raise revenue from the colonies

questions.question: What was a major North American result of the 1763 peace settlement?
choices: France gained Virginia
Britain surrendered Canada
Britain acquired Canada from France
Spain acquired the thirteen British colonies

questions.question: Why did the Proclamation of 1763 anger many British colonists?
choices: It restricted settlement west of the Appalachian Mountains
It required all colonists to move to Canada
It ended colonial participation in Atlantic trade
It made French the language of colonial courts

questions.question: Why did British leaders establish the Proclamation Line after the war?
choices: To prepare to return Canada to France
To limit frontier conflict and regulate expansion
To eliminate the need for colonial governors
To stop shipping between Britain and America

questions.question: How did the war change Britain's position in eastern North America?
choices: It made Britain dependent on French military protection
It reduced Britain's land claims to coastal cities
It ended Britain's ability to regulate colonial commerce
It removed France as a major imperial territorial rival there

questions.question: Which sequence correctly places these French and Indian War events?
choices: Albany Plan → Treaty of Paris → Quebec captured
Treaty of Paris → Quebec captured → Albany Plan
Albany Plan → Quebec captured → Treaty of Paris
Quebec captured → Albany Plan → Treaty of Paris

questions.question: A map shows French forts linking Canada with the Mississippi River. What purpose does that pattern suggest?
choices: Connecting French claims through the interior
Surrounding the Spanish capital in Mexico
Protecting British plantation exports
Separating Canada from inland trade

questions.question: A colonial merchant celebrates British victory but later protests new taxes. Which explanation best connects those reactions?
choices: Victory allowed colonial assemblies to set British tax policy
Britain's expanded empire also brought new financial demands
Victory transferred tax collection from Parliament to France
The treaty limited British taxation to merchants in Canada

questions.question: Why is it inaccurate to describe the war as all Europeans fighting all Indigenous peoples?
choices: Most fighting involved only civilian settlers rather than armies
Indigenous nations joined the fighting only after the peace treaty
Both European sides formed alliances with Indigenous nations
The conflict centered on European religious reforms rather than territorial claims

questions.question: Which source would most directly show how an Indigenous leader understood an alliance during this war?
choices: A colonial map showing locations of British forts
A French trader's inventory of goods sent to several villages
A British officer's report estimating troop strength
A recorded speech by that leader about the alliance
